correctness.rationale: Independent exhaustive replay enumerated all 65536 subsets and reproduced cardinality counts (1,16,88,208,228,128,56,16,2) and augmented oriented boundary ranks (1,15,73,135,86,42,14,2) over F101. Rational boundary ranks cannot be smaller, so rational Betti numbers are bounded by the modular ones; the reduced Euler characteristic −7 forces exactly seven rational classes in degree three. Automorphisms fixing zero act faithfully on its four neighbors: for a vertex of weight w, the distances to those neighbors determine its entire support. After translating zero, this exhausts all 384 maps. For a fixed face with c vertex cycles the negative reduced Lefschetz contribution is (−1)^c, including the empty face; the independent replay used this rule and matched every character value, with distribution −3:24, −1:161, 1:188, 3:6, 5:4, 7:1. The translation Fourier weights are 0 with multiplicity three and 7,11,13,14 each with multiplicity one; the latter are transitively permuted, which proves absolute irreducibility. The explicit signed monomial action is a representation and has the remaining trace after averaging out translations; equality of characters over characteristic zero gives the rational identification. Rational averaging on a barycentric subdivision proves the quotient conclusions. Replay of the six subgroup averages gave (3,3,3,0,1,0), in the order of frozen proof §4.
residual_risks: Checks are exact for Q4 only; no general-cube theorem, integral decomposition or equivariant homotopy type follows from them.
The rank-one quotient refers to pure even coordinate permutations, not a subgroup also containing all translations.
